posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I have been WAITING for this one. FASHIOOON! :D

Christopher speaks the truth: I would also read those comics, and they would not be that good because they would be serious. XD

Killflip is 100% a SkaytBlayd villain.

Fashion's superpower is having a dress with pockets.

"Not about Sentinels Tactics!" Wow, Christopher. Low blow. Harsh. Wow.

She looks so good for pushing 80. :) God, I love her freckles.

It's amazing how answers to a few key questions, like her age, really make the story of Shirley Shane in the modern era one worth telling.

So glad we could get that enlightening answer about curse removal. :V

"Sexpatriette", huh? Someone needs to put a leash on Christopher, he's completely out of control.

Oh dear, I sure hope Ra doesn't come to understand Setback's curse, he'll burn Pete to a crisp! D:

But he's also right, Tori Amos's "Smells Like Teen Spirit" is great.

A bit late to the party here, but even though I’m not one of the people who is super interested in this character, I did have a couple of thoughts about her which I figured it wasn’t entirely too late to share.

  1. The name S’sdari is a corruption of her actual name Shirley being mangled by several different alien tongues in a lengthy game of Telephone across the period of her captivity. Shirley → Sharley → Shar’di → Sh’dari → S’sdari, or something along similar lines.

  2. I forget what my second observation was; I’ll re-listen to the episode in a few days and edit it back in if I remember.
